class.name: FellowCrashReporter
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: crash reports from shipped games — what crashed, where, and what the game was doing.

method.name: acknowledge_reports
method.description: Marks the reports written so far as seen: [method get_pending_report] returns none until another run writes one.

method.name: add_breadcrumb
method.description: Notes what the game is doing (a level loaded, a menu opened, a save written); the last 64 go into the report with the milliseconds since the start. Cheap (a copy into a ring); text over 200 bytes is cut. The reporter adds its own: the engine's start and each change of the current scene.

method.name: debug_crash
method.description: Crashes the process on purpose, to test the reports and what collects them: [code]"segfault"[/code] (a null pointer written), [code]"abort"[/code], [code]"trap"[/code] (Godot's [code]CRASH_NOW[/code]), [code]"stack_overflow"[/code], [code]"thread"[/code] (a null pointer written on another thread), [code]"divide"[/code] (an integer divided by zero; no fault on ARM).

method.name: get_custom_values
method.description: The values set with [method set_custom_value], as text.

method.name: get_pending_report
method.description: The newest report an earlier run wrote and [method acknowledge_reports] has not marked, as [method read_report] returns it; empty when there is none (or the reports are off).

method.name: get_report_directory
method.description: Where the reports are written (an absolute path ending with a separator); empty when they are off.

method.name: get_reports
method.description: The reports in the directory (crashes, hangs, and those [method write_report] wrote), newest first: their absolute paths.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Diagnostics: [code]enabled[/code], [code]installed[/code] (the handlers), [code]log_capacity[/code], [code]log_lines_seen[/code], [code]log_lines_kept[/code], [code]breadcrumbs[/code], [code]reports_written[/code], [code]setup_usec[/code] (the reporter's start-up), [code]watchdog[/code], [code]hang_ms[/code], [code]hangs[/code], [code]hang_signal[/code] (Linux, macOS), [code]frame[/code], [code]scene[/code] and [code]context[/code] (the machine, as a report has it).

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Whether reports are written in this process: [member ProjectSettings.debug/fellow/crash_reports/enabled] and FellowEngine on, and not the editor.

method.name: is_uploading
method.description: Whether [method upload_reports] is sending reports now.

method.name: read_report
method.description: A report's JSON as a [Dictionary], with [code skip-lint]path[/code] added (and [code]minidump_path[/code] when its minidump is beside it). Its keys: [code]kind[/code] ([code]"crash"[/code], [code]"hang"[/code] or [code]"report"[/code]), [code]reason[/code], [code]signal[/code] and [code]code[/code] or the exception's [code]code[/code], [code]fault_address[/code], [code]access[/code], [code]time_utc[/code], [code]uptime_ms[/code], [code]frame[/code], [code]thread[/code], [code]scene[/code], [code]memory[/code], [code]context[/code], [code]frames[/code], [code]breadcrumbs[/code], [code]custom[/code], [code]log[/code], [code]script_backtraces[/code], [code]minidump[/code]; a hang's [code]stalled_ms[/code], [code]recovered_after_ms[/code] and [code]script_frames[/code].

method.name: remove_custom_value
method.description: Takes a value set with [method set_custom_value] out of the reports.

method.name: set_custom_value
method.description: A value the reports carry (the level, the player's position, the build's branch), as text: up to 32 keys of up to 46 bytes, values cut at 206 bytes. Setting a key again replaces its value.

method.name: upload_reports
method.description: Sends the reports waiting in the directory (those of [method get_reports], oldest first) to [param url] — empty: [member ProjectSettings.debug/fellow/crash_reports/upload_url] — on a thread of its own, and returns at once: [constant OK], or [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] (the reports off), [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] (no URL, or not [code]http://[/code] or [code]https://[/code]), [constant ERR_BUSY] (sending already). Each report is a POST of [code]multipart/form-data[/code]: [code]report[/code] (its JSON, as a file), [code]upload_file_minidump[/code] (its minidump, with [member ProjectSettings.debug/fellow/crash_reports/upload_minidumps]), and the fields [code]kind[/code], [code]reason[/code], [code]project[/code], [code]version[/code] and [code]commit[/code]. HTTPS checks the collector's certificate against Godot's certificates ([member ProjectSettings.network/tls/certificate_bundle_override] to use others). A report the collector accepts (2xx) is moved into the directory's [code]sent/[/code] folder; [signal report_uploaded] for each, [signal uploads_finished] at the end.

method.name: write_report
method.description: Writes a report now without crashing ([code]kind[/code] [code]"report"[/code]: a state the game should not be in, a failed save), with the calling thread's frames and its script's backtrace; returns its path (empty when the reports are off). Not pending for this run.

signal.name: report_uploaded
signal.description: A report [method upload_reports] tried to send: its path (where it was), whether the collector accepted it (moved into [code]sent/[/code]), and the collector's HTTP response code, or when there was none: [code]-1[/code] (the URL not understood), [code]-2[/code] (its host not found), [code]-3[/code] (no connection within 10 s), [code]-4[/code] (the TLS handshake failed: the certificate not trusted), [code]-5[/code] (no response within 30 s and a second for each 100 KB). When the collector is not reached ([code]-2[/code] to [code]-4[/code]) the reports after it are not tried: they get the same code.

signal.name: uploads_finished
signal.description: [method upload_reports] is done: how many reports the collector accepted and how many it did not (they stay in the directory for the next try).
